description: Narrow and elongated. Living bright bedrooms dim. Deep — views through multiple spaces. Short connecting link between entry and living area. Kitchen: L-shaped or U-shaped, no island or peninsula — counter set back from windows, moderate natural light. Cook faces the wall — back to the living and dining area. Two cooks can work simultaneously on separate counter runs. Fully open plan — no wall separates kitchen from dining and living. Living arrangement: linear kitchen-dining-living, kitchen on side wall. Seating: A sofa at the rear of the apartment faces a TV against the lower wall; a dining table with four chairs sits in the middle zone near the kitchen.. Dining table (4 seats). TV on wall opposite wall to entry. Cook cannot see TV from cooking position. Diners do not face the TV. Entry: corridor entry, first thing visible on arrival is blank wall, straight corridor, short. No door between entry and living — relevant where local regulations require separation. Studio apartment. Double bed. Bed partially visible from front door, visible from kitchen. Fully open plan — cooking smells and sounds reach the sleeping area directly. Storage: generous wardrobe storage. One bathroom (shower, bathtub, and toilet). Single bathroom — all household members share one shower, sequential morning routine. Suits: singles or couples comfortable with combined living and sleeping space. Not suitable for: families with children (studio with single open sleeping zone); roommates needing separate private bedrooms; anyone needing a dedicated home office (no desk or enclosed work room).
